videos.title: 10 Years of Bardot Brush: Looking Back on It All
videos.description:
Bardot Brush is 10 years old today!! 🥹🎉

On November 6, 2016, I uploaded my first three Procreate brush sets for sale, having absolutely no idea where that little creative experiment would take me.

Ten years later, I'm looking back on how it all started, the unexpected twists and turns, the things I've created, and the incredible people I've met along the way. videos.title: Adjustment Layers are coming to Procreate 6!
videos.description:
Adjustment Layers are coming to Procreate 6!

Soon you'll be able to make non-destructive adjustments to your artwork with the flexibility to go back and edit them anytime!

Rearrange adjustment layers in your layer stack, clip them to groups, and fine-tune your adjustments without permanently changing your artwork.

Procreate 6 is still in development and is planned for release sometime in 2027.

Follow for more sneak peeks of new Procreate 6 features! #procreate #procreateart #lightboxexpo #pr

videos.title: Gap Detection for Color Drop in Procreate 6
videos.description:
Gap Detection is coming to Color Drop in Procreate 6!

Soon small gaps in your line art will be no match for Color Drop. With the new Gap Detection feature, you'll be able to control whether your color fills through those gaps or stays neatly contained within your lines.

Procreate 6 is still in development and is planned for release sometime in 2027.

Follow for more sneak peeks of new Procreate 6 features! #procreate #procreateart #lightboxexpo #procreate6
